benchmarks.name: Level 1 vs Level 2a
benchmarks.metric: Aqua daylight (0 h latency), Level 1 minus Level 2a median, 54 region-years 2012 to 2020
benchmarks.threshold: every gap <= 30 min; any larger gap explained with numbers
benchmarks.value: max |gap| 45.5 min; 49 of 54 within 30 min, 5 over
evidence: br-amazon: max gap +1.5 min (2018), 0 of 9 years over 30 min
br-cerrado: max gap -1.2 min (2012), 0 of 9 years over 30 min
br-pantanal: max gap -5.7 min (2014), 0 of 9 years over 30 min
ar-argentina: max gap -30.9 min (2014), 2 of 9 years over 30 min
in-punjab-haryana: max gap -12.5 min (2012), 0 of 9 years over 30 min
us-california: max gap -45.5 min (2018), 3 of 9 years over 30 min

ar-argentina 2014: gap -30.9 min = look time +0.1 + fire dates -26.1 (median detection date 2014-08-22 vs season middle 2014-08-15; 50% of detections in the season months) + latitude -5.0 (median -27.9 vs box centre -38.5); sum -30.9

ar-argentina 2017: gap -30.3 min = look time +0.1 + fire dates -24.8 (median detection date 2017-08-19 vs season middle 2017-08-15; 54% of detections in the season months) + latitude -5.5 (median -28.2 vs box centre -38.5); sum -30.3

us-california 2012: gap -36.2 min = look time +0.1 + fire dates -32.4 (median detection date 2012-08-16 vs season middle 2012-09-15; 66% of detections in the season months) + latitude -3.8 (median 40.0 vs box centre 37.2); sum -36.2

us-california 2015: gap -31.9 min = look time -0.3 + fire dates -29.3 (median detection date 2015-08-16 vs season middle 2015-09-15; 59% of detections in the season months) + latitude -2.3 (median 38.9 vs box centre 37.2); sum -31.9

us-california 2018: gap -45.5 min = look time -0.2 + fire dates -42.4 (median detection date 2018-08-08 vs season middle 2018-09-15; 57% of detections in the season months) + latitude -2.9 (median 39.3 vs box centre 37.2); sum -45.5

Cause: Level 1 is one day (season middle) at one latitude (box centre) by its definition; real fires burn on other dates and latitudes. Not a code error: B1 to B5 hold and each gap splits fully into date and latitude terms.
Team decision (Nov 14): keep Level 1 as specified; quote the Level 2a median for ar-argentina, us-california (headline.quote = level2a in their JSON).

evidence.auditor_notes: Round 1: 10 values (5 seeded, 5 non-zero). Round 2: 12 headline values. Sunset by the auditor's own NOAA-equation code, cross-checked against an astropy ephemeris (within about 3 s). Auditor's flags: four seeded targets are zero shares and test little; shares that sit on a threshold move with a few seconds of sunset (Amazon 2025 after-dark share at 3 h: 2,036 of 27,575 detections lie within 1 minute of the threshold); the Punjab season window Oct to Dec beats Sep to Nov by under 1 percent.
